author: Adamtheknight
body:
Hi staff,

My username is adamtheknight I play on avicus from about early 2014 but i was stopped from then.
A member of staff called Gambelojer (I think that's how you spell it) banned me as i was advertising.
We were in a game of elimination and he told me this server is getting a bit boring wanna play something else?
I told him sure what you wanna play? He then said hunger games? I said ok but then he said what's the ip so I typed it in, in chat and he banned me first thing for advertising. This upset me a lot as me and gabelojer was very close as friends and he almost like set me up to get banned. If you wouldn't mind could you please solve this case and unban me please as i was really set up by gabelojer to get myself banned. A lot of people has had bad blood with gabelojer too and I think he was de ranked from his position if you could understand me It was an accident as I did'nt release the outcome as I was asked the question for me to follow up by writing the Ip. By the way I do not ban evade, hack or all those stuff.

Thanks a lot guys hope you could solve this problem 
Adamtheknight
